label: For "Repository-Aware Code Completion": Suggest the next lines and functions while a developer types, using the open files and the repository's own conventions, so common code is written faster and consistent with the codebase. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Shown-suggestion metrics.
